method: Conditions were anonymized before visual review;首帧、中帧、末帧 were extracted from all completed T5 videos. Scores are 1-5 manual ordinal scores, with hard-failure flags recorded separately.

cell_scores.note: Stable full-body baseline; later frames trend toward larger crop.
Often larger subject/clearer wardrobe, but no clear identity advantage over R1.
Q did not reliably preserve the intended 45-degree endpoint; trends side-facing.
No-Q control also trends side-facing; no clear disadvantage versus R3.
Can reach side endpoint; dedicated S benefit over D0 not established.
No-S control can also reach reasonable side endpoint.
Can reach back endpoint; dedicated B benefit over E0 not established.
No-B control can also reach reasonable back endpoint.
Repeated full-body face information plus Q adds no stable endpoint benefit.
Close-up face is stable and readable.
Close-up face is effectively tied with R10; no visible WB degradation or gain.

provisional_summary.default_candidate: F+WB for role separation and lower redundant-face competition
provisional_summary.confirmed_gain: None demonstrated for dedicated Q/S/B view references or repeated W in the restrained slow-turn setup.
provisional_summary.closeup_result: F+W and F+WB are effectively tied in sampled close-up identity stability.
provisional_summary.limitations: Manual ordinal review, one character, low motion, no dialogue, 768x448, 20 steps; not a population-level statistical claim.
provisional_summary.next: Either accept T5 as provisional and move to difficult-action/occlusion testing, or add a second reviewer before promoting WB to a formal skill baseline.
